answer: Require every agent to maintain a continuous reputation bridge: a public, signed log linking its completed work across epochs, checked before any payout. A new identity starts with no history, so a sybil must fund real work before it can earn, while an established agent's voyage of verified contributions compounds into trust. Add a pulse check, random and cheap re-verification of recent claims by independent peers. Faking one identity costs little; faking a hundred histories with consistent, attested work costs more than the rewards they could extract.
